structuredContent.body:
CURRENT needed to distinguish reproduced development quality and resource curves from adequately trained scientific benefit, and to state what the actual original training traces retained.

This stage connects the frozen original42/C1 curves, all six independently replayed HCSN best checkpoints, and the finding that all retained original trace records are at update zero. Missing observations, budget censoring, common-LR selection and target-time conventions are explicit. The exact hosted science head/merge/tree is recorded separately from earlier blocking-CI failures.

The first commit is a mechanical appendix preserving the independent index review, exact hosted-fixture cost fields, failed wrapper entries, successful working/Git checks and API publication reconciliation. The second commit changes only CURRENT and the science workflow: six evidence manifests and eight linked documents are checked using the established module entry. No acceptance threshold, training source or scientific-admission gate is changed.

Validation: existing integrity checker passed 1,053 manifest files, 51 ZIPs and 287 links. The post-commit Git-object proof passed 1,068 distinct regular blobs, including all six manifests and 230 explicitly bound entrypoint dependencies. Formatter completed with unchanged inputs; diff checks passed. At the two-commit evidence/status snapshot, remote whole tree aa5cc6bc55b0dc1cb68adf62886fb9646962de03 equals local commit a33490f926debd60ce21f73b2ea64c1b90b8338a.

HCSN still has 0/6 adequate original fits; full-trajectory numerical qualification and scientific benefit remain HOLD. Stacked on #5848. Draft only, with no main merge or release publication.

A third, narrowly scoped CI commit preserves one immutable Base64 transport receipt while excluding that exact file from prose spelling. Codespell 2.4.3 reproduces the five original false positives; with the one-path scope correction, the complete HCSN evidence directory and CURRENT pass. The original receipt bytes and evidence SHA gates are unchanged. This does not fix or exempt the unrelated contract, platform-checkout or build failures. Current remote head fdbc954bb259a709275771fe151b4f0c8d245b48 has the same whole tree 626a3ee0ba89432a5203fc00687f8e21781a472b as local commit 390941a5e0bb7b5232271b021bd1efd77bcd05fe.
